1otus.text: 1otus plays a sharp, tidy game at the summit: in the top sliver of everyone tracked, brisk tempo behind it, sustaining the output as the opposition improves. That matchup kill-death figure runs close to the top. The strongest-third share lands in the middle. A tidy game, sharp from first to last.

1os.text: 1Os is a young account with a loud opening: barely a few weeks in, and already tempo and bravery both among the very best tracked. Their resistance sits near the very top, the aim is precise, and headshots land in a strong share. Early read, but the first pages carry real weight — this one arrived playing at full speed.

187err.text: 187err is pure velocity: a top-tier work rate, nerve to match, and pace to burn, with accuracy and headshots among the best tracked. The lifetime board sits right up there with the matchups, and the kills come in a flood. The consistency mark trails below average — the only quiet note in a deafening card.

1nfinity666.text: 1nfinity666 plays a veteran's game: rating, bravery, and resistance all stand top-tier, with pace to match. Headshots land at a brisk clip and the aim remains sharp, so the kills come quick and clean. The lifetime board sits shoulder to shoulder with the matchups — a career that has held its level for years.

163roma.text: 163roma has been at this since 2015, and the card reads like a metronome: above average on the matchup rating, tempo, bravery, resistance, and nearly every other line. Accuracy and consistency both sit mid-pack, the only ordinary notes in an otherwise strong record. A veteran regular who shows up, holds their ground, and keeps the scoreboard tilted their way.
